name: pump_visualizer_3d
summary: Python-side 3D wave field renderer that consumes pump.fun stream events (pump_stream_ingest JSONL) + per-wallet GMM/XGBoost gate decisions and emits a WaveFrame JSON consumable by the Godot pump_surf_godot_scene (sibling agent G). Each transaction becomes a 'ripple' in 3D space: X=time (newest right), Y=log(sol_amount) normalized to window, Z=bot_probability. Color is derived from the gate decision (bot=red, human=green, mid-band=green->red interpolation, surf_target=gold and always overrides). intensity is priority_fee normalized to the window's [min,max]. Every build_wave_frame call crystal-anchors via inference_logger (tier='visualization', model='pump_visualizer_3d', scope='wave_frame_built') and persists the WaveFrame JSON to ~/.cc/pump_waves/<crystal_short>.json. Stdlib only (json, math, dataclasses, pathlib, xml.etree.ElementTree for SVG preview). SVG preview is a top-down 2D projection (X-time x Y-amount, Z encoded as color) at 800x400 for dApp panels, emails, and audit.
engine_pattern: Two-pass build over a [now-window_seconds, now] event window. Pass 1 collects log1p(sol_amount) and priority_fee ranges for normalization (handles flat windows + zero amounts with eps). Pass 2 emits one Ripple per in-window event: x = (ts - t_lo) / window, y = (log_amt - amt_min) / amt_span, z = clamp(bot_probability, 0, 1), color = _color_for(bp, is_surf), intensity = (fee - fee_min) / fee_span. Aggregate signals: bot_density_avg = mean(bot_probability), human_inflow_score = mean(human_inflow_score) over gate_decisions. surf_state derived from the locked truth table. crystal anchor + ~/.cc/pump_waves/<crystal_short>.json persisted as a side-effect of build_wave_frame.

api.main_function: build_wave_frame(events: list[dict], gate_decisions: dict[str, dict], window_seconds: int = 60, active_position: bool = False, now: float | None = None) -> WaveFrame
api.serialize: serialize_wave(wave: WaveFrame, output_path: Path | None = None) -> str
api.preview: render_svg_preview(wave: WaveFrame, output_path: Path | None = None, width: int = 800, height: int = 400) -> Path

Ripple.y: float in [0,1] - normalized log(sol_amount) within window
Ripple.intensity: float in [0,1] - priority_fee normalized to window's [min,max]

WaveFrame.captured_at: float - unix timestamp at build time
WaveFrame.window_seconds: int - width of the time window
WaveFrame.crystal: str - inference_logger chain crystal id (empty if logger unavailable)

color_mapping.interp_band: 0.3 < bp < 0.7 -> linear interpolation green -> red across the band
color_mapping.intensity: priority_fee_lamports normalized to window's [min,max] (drives ripple size + glow in Godot)

surf_state_derivation._order: abort first (most dangerous), then exit_imminent, then surf_candidate, else no_signal

godot_scene_json_contract.endpoint: GET /dapp/api/pump_wave (served by dapp; reads the latest WaveFrame JSON file from ~/.cc/pump_waves/)
godot_scene_json_contract.shape: { captured_at: float, window_seconds: int, ripples: [Ripple...], bot_density_avg: float, human_inflow_score: float, surf_state: str, crystal: str }
godot_consumption_notes: Godot pump_surf_godot_scene reads ripples[*] and maps {x,y,z} to world-space (with its own scale factor)
color_rgba is passed straight into the particle shader; alpha drives surface glow
intensity drives ripple radius + emission energy
is_surf_target ripples should render as anchor points (Godot can pin a Camera3D look-at on the brightest one)
surf_state drives the scene's overlay HUD (red=abort, gold=surf_candidate, orange=exit_imminent, neutral=no_signal)

substrate: ~/.cc/pump_waves/<crystal_short>.json (one file per build_wave_frame call) + crystal anchor in ~/.cc/inference_master_chain.jsonl (tier='visualization', model='pump_visualizer_3d', scope='wave_frame_built'). When inference_logger is unavailable, files fall back to ~/.cc/pump_waves/nochain_<unix_ts>.json.

inbound_callers: dApp HTTP GET /dapp/api/pump_wave (serves the latest persisted WaveFrame)
Godot pump_surf_godot_scene (sibling agent G, reads via the dApp endpoint)
routing_connections.substrate_reads: events JSONL from pump_stream_ingest, gate decisions JSON from the GMM/XGBoost gate (per-wallet bot_probability + human_inflow_score + decision)

guarantees: Stdlib only — json + math + dataclasses + pathlib + xml.etree.ElementTree + argparse + time
JSON contract is asdict(WaveFrame); each ripple is asdict(Ripple); stable field order (Python 3.7+ insertion order)
Color mapping is deterministic for a fixed (bp, is_surf) input — no RNG anywhere in the pipeline
surf_state derivation is a locked truth table (order: abort -> exit_imminent -> surf_candidate -> no_signal)
X axis: time, normalized to [0,1] across window; clamped on the edges
Y axis: log1p(sol_amount + eps) normalized to window's [min,max]; eps handles zero amounts
intensity is priority_fee normalized to window's [min,max]; flat windows degrade to 0.0
Crystal anchor is best-effort — failures log to stderr but do NOT block the WaveFrame return
Persistence is best-effort — file write failures log to stderr but do NOT raise
SVG preview is a 800x400 top-down 2D projection (stdlib xml.etree only); surf_target ripples render last so they sit on top with a white stroke
smoke_protocol: python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('core/lib/pump_visualizer_3d.py').read())" && python3 core/lib/pump_visualizer_3d.py build --events <synth.jsonl> --gates <synth.json> --window 60 --out /tmp/wave.json && python3 core/lib/pump_visualizer_3d.py preview /tmp/wave.json --out /tmp/wave.svg
future_v1_hooks: WebSocket streaming variant (push ripples as they're classified instead of polling)
Heatmap overlay aggregating by mint (one color column per token)
Per-wallet trail mode (link a wallet's ripples across the window with a polyline)
Adaptive window (longer when activity sparse, shorter when storming)
GodotEngine native binary shape (eg. MessagePack) for the inner-loop HTTP path
Tighten the abort/candidate thresholds based on real run feedback from the surf executor
phase: pump.fun surf sibling agents — Python-side viz (agent V)
